اشتكين (form VIII)
# اِشْتَكَيْنَ (ištakayna) /iʃ.ta.kaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# اُشْتُكِينَ (uštukīna) /uʃ.tu.kiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# اِشْتَكِينَ (ištakīna) /iʃ.ta.kiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
